decision: run S0-S6 continuously under GOAL.md with poteto-mode active
why: full-autonomy overnight grant; exit condition is all stages delivered plus final acceptance

decision: kept Windows venv layout as the baseline and only re-ran pytest+ruff before touching anything
why: first change should be verification, not code; catches a broken starting point

decision: chose WSL2 Ubuntu as the Unix platform
why: forbidden to stop for a missing Unix env; WSL is the available Unix with uv installed

decision: solved WSL egress with a host-side byte relay bound to the WSL gateway instead of changing proxy app settings or WSL networking mode
why: proxy app and mirrored mode are user system state; a relay is reversible and scoped to this run
result: egress works, no user config touched

decision: cloned from the main repository instead of the worktree directory
why: for a worktree .git file holds an absolute Windows path POSIX git cannot follow
evidence: clone error then success at bc191e0

decision: made run_e2e.py pick interpreter paths by os.name instead of forking a Unix copy
why: one harness, two platforms; the process start and stop logic was already platform-aware

decision: ran the Linux suite with no_proxy=127.0.0.1,localhost
why: urllib would otherwise route loopback health checks into the relay and fail

decision: added a static no-filesystem-writes scan to test_packaging
why: GOAL quality floor asks for a private-import and file-write static scan; encoding it as a test reruns itself

decision: moved authorization into per-target allowed_callers with identity from --caller
why: ROADMAP S1 says the caller is per registry entry; MCP gives no trusted caller context, so the launch config is the only honest identity source

decision: kept schema 1 loading by normalizing into the same model
why: one canonical model beats two code paths, and the v1 e2e scenarios double as the back-compat proof
evidence: _load_v1 in config.py, delegate_basic PASS on Linux

decision: used snake_case json keys for new fields
why: consistency with the existing api_key_env style beats copying the roadmap's camelCase prose

decision: scoped credential resolution to the caller's reachable targets
why: a middle-hop bot must not hold keys for bots it cannot call anyway

decision: embedded the envelope as a preamble in the task text and let the middle bot copy it into tool args
why: MCP has no trusted cross-instance context; the task text is the only channel that reaches the middle bot

decision: validated envelope values as structured untrusted input with local invariant checks
why: model-mediated values can be wrong or hostile; only shape, hops, loops, and budget caps are enforceable without a ledger

decision: handed each next hop 90 percent of the remaining deadline
why: a proportional reserve keeps the budget strictly decreasing without clock sync between instances

decision: fixed missing MCP env key by adding extra_mcp_env to the harness planner config
why: the MCP subprocess exits before registering tools when a target key is missing, which reads as a missing tool on the model side
result: root cause fixed, not papered over
